conventions.walkForward: first 40% of signal days = initial training; then blocks of ceil(10% of days); theta per block = argmax training flat-stake ROI (headline fee, 1c haircut) with >= max(15, 1% of training windows) trades; OOS = all blocks
conventions.bootstrap: day-clustered, 2000 reps, ROI = sum(pnl)/n; one-sided centred p for H0 ROI<=0
conventions.bh: Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 across ALL variants in this file
conventions.verdictRule: candidate-edge = BH-significant AND bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND ROI > 0 under the minp stress fee AND under a 2c haircut; inconclusive = oosN < 100 or (headline ROI > 0 with CI upper > +5%); else no-edge
conventions.capacity: capPerTradeUsd = median live ask depth within 2c of best ask on in-play tokens (from saved snapshots); capProfitPerDay = tradesPerDay * capPerTradeUsd * max(ROI,0)
